items.question: Which WNBA teams did Courtney Paris play for?
items.answer: Courtney Paris has played for the Sacramento Monarchs, Atlanta Dream, Tulsa Shock, Dallas Wings and Seattle Storm.

items.question: Where did Courtney Paris play college basketball?
items.answer: Courtney Paris played at Oklahoma, where she averaged 21.4 points and 15.3 rebounds and set the NCAA record with 112 straight double-doubles.

items.question: What were Courtney Paris' WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Courtney Paris averaged 4.7 points and 5.4 rebounds in 297 WNBA regular-season games from 2009 to 2019. She led the league in rebounding in 2014 (10.2 per game) and 2015 (9.3) with Tulsa.

items.question: Did Courtney Paris play for the Chicago Sky?
items.answer: No. The Chicago Sky took Courtney Paris fourth in the December 2009 dispersal draft, but waived her in May 2010 before she played a regular-season game for them.
